messages.subject: Progress bar graphics
parts:
Hi,

I tried to use shinyIncubator package progress bar but for some reason graphics are different than in this example:
http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/progress-example.html

Do I have to change graphics manually some how?

Same question in SO with pictures:
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/27485633/shinyincubator-package-progressbar-default-graphics-and-how-to-change-it

-Mikael

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Progress bar graphics
parts: A progress bar has been added to Shiny itself, so you no longer need to use shinyIncubator. The appearance of the progress bar in Shiny is different from the version that was in shinyIncubator. I'll update shinyIncubator to remove its progress bar.

messages.author: 459ee2ad234219fa
messages.subject: Re: Progress bar graphics
parts:
Oh, good to know, I liked the graphics of shinyIncubator(and also my beta testers). By the way latest github version of shiny with bootstrap 3 messes up shinyIncubator graphics(progress message goes under navbar). So I think I have to any way stick in standard solution. Which is sad because standard progress messages are quite small... I use progress messages to tell users when they have modified or saved new file to datastructure so it is actually important for them that they notice that they have saved file. Bigger progress bar would have been nice in long computation when user doesn't have anything else to do than just look at progress bar. 

Thanks for your reply,
Mikael
